memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Rheumatoid arthritis with active synovitis and benign prostatic hyperplasia with lower urinary tract symptoms.
He reports morning stiffness in hands lasting about 45 minutes, mild joint swelling in MCP joints, and occasional fatigue. He also describes nocturia twice nightly, weak stream, and feeling of incomplete bladder emptying. On exam, there is mild tenderness and warmth in bilateral MCP joints, no deformities. Prostate exam shows mildly enlarged, smooth, non-tender prostate.
Smoking status: former smoker, quit 2000, pack-years 30.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
methotrexate 10 mg once weekly
folic acid 5 mg once weekly
hydroxychloroquine 200 mg OD

finasteride 5 mg OD

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Rheumatoid arthritis with moderate activity and benign prostatic hyperplasia with worsening LUTS.
He notes increased hand pain and swelling over past month, morning stiffness now ~60 minutes, mild fatigue. Urinary symptoms: nocturia three times, weak stream, occasional urgency. Exam: synovitis and tenderness in bilateral MCP and PIP joints, no deformities. Prostate feels slightly firmer, estimated volume ~48 mL.
Smoking status: former smoker, quit 2000, pack-years 30.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Ultrasound KUB: Prostate volume 48 mL, homogeneous echotexture. Post‑void residual urine 35 mL. No significant hydronephrosis. Bladder wall thickness normal.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Referral to Dr. Priya Nair, Rheumatology, for assessment of refractory rheumatoid arthritis and consideration of biologic therapy.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Rheumatology review: Patient continues methotrexate 15 mg weekly with inadequate response. Advised to add sulfasalazine 500 mg BD and consider TNF‑alpha inhibitor if no improvement in 8 weeks.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Rheumatoid arthritis with persistent synovitis despite methotrexate increase; benign prostatic hyperplasia stable.
Patient reports ongoing hand pain, morning stiffness ~55 minutes, mild fatigue. No new joint swelling. Urinary symptoms unchanged: nocturia twice, weak stream. Exam: mild tenderness in MCP joints, no deformities. Prostate unchanged.
Smoking status: former smoker, quit 2000, pack-years 30.
